notes: Budget preparation: budget header, account lines (AC_ESTIMATE_MAST) and period values (AC_ESTIMATE_DET, linked to the account line by MAST_SERIAL: the generator cannot nest a third level). Account / cost centre / period checks, no duplicates, copy budget and budget from actual buttons (APP_RULES3_GL, see processes/ACESTMT_PERIODS_TRNS.md)

AC_ESTIMATE_DET.MAST_SERIAL.lov: select m.serial || ' - ' || m.account_number || ' ' || (select max(a.account_name) from ac_master a where a.account_number = m.account_number) d, m.serial r from ac_estimate_mast m where m.est_code = :PAGE_EST_CODE order by m.serial

AC_ESTIMATE_DET.FROM_DATE.sql: (select max(p.from_date) from ac_estimate_periods p where p.period_code = t.period_code)

AC_ESTIMATE_DET.TILL_DATE.sql: (select max(p.till_date) from ac_estimate_periods p where p.period_code = t.period_code)
